title: IAMMAI v1 Governance Action Body
description: Canonical governance action body schema for v1. This schema defines the governance action as artifact only. It preserves attributable, legitimacy-bounded, matter-scoped lawful action without carrying execution, envelope, registry, preservation, or transport context as canonical body content.

governance_action_id.description: Artifact identity for the governance action body. This is not execution or envelope identity.

action_type.description: Typed governance action preserved by the artifact body.

authority_class.description: Bounded authority class under which the governance action counted as lawful protocol force.

actor_ref.description: Canonical reference to the actor that performed or authorized the governance action.

legitimacy_basis_ref.description: Canonical reference to the lawful basis under which the governance action counted.

matter_ref.description: Canonical reference to the bounded matter to which the governance action applies.

acted_at.description: Time at which the governance action occurred.

delegated_from_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to the delegating source where the action was performed under delegation.

target_state_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to the target state affected by the governance action where state relation is part of action standing.

target_transition_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to the target transition affected by the governance action where transition relation is part of action standing.

related_validation_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a related validation artifact where that relation is part of governance action standing.

related_witness_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a related witness artifact where that relation is part of governance action standing.
